obligations.name: channels_with_eyes_reaction_from_core_infra_member
obligations.description: Channels containing at least one message that received an eyes-emoji reaction from a user who also holds core-infra channel membership
obligations.scope: messages, reactions, and channel memberships visible to the acting user across accessible channels

task_spec.text: Identify the channels that contain a message reacted to with 👀 by someone who is also a member of #core-infra.

access_plan: The acting bot user is a member of engineering, model-research, growth, frontend, and core-infra channels, so it can call conversations.history on each candidate channel to see messages, reactions.get (or the visible message_reactions) to find eyes reactions, and conversations.members on core-infra to confirm which reactors are also core-infra members, discovering the qualifying engineering and model-research channels while excluding growth (wrong reactor membership) and frontend (wrong emoji).
